inj.note: On the heels of two games on the sideline due to a concussion and a foot injury, Egbuka kicked off this week as a non-participant Wednesday before logging back-to-back full sessions Thursday and Friday. Despite clearing the protocol for head injuries ahead of Week 8 action, he was listed as questionable with the foot issue ahead of Sunday's matchup, but report indicates Egbuka is trending toward active status. Egbuka's availability will be clarified approximately 90 minutes before an 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff.

news.h: Baker Mayfield returns for Bucs, but WR Emeka Egbuka, RT Luke Goedeke out
news.d: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield will make his return following a three-game absence, but he will be without his top target in wide receiver Emeka Egbuka.
